claim: A metabolomic QTL analysis was conducted on a reciprocal RIL population structured to examine how variation in the organelle genomes affects phenotypic variation.
source_text: We conducted a metabolomic QTL analysis on a reciprocal RIL population structured to examine how variation in the organelle genomes affects phenotypic variation.
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by the experimental design and data collection described in the manuscript, including metabolomic measurements on the Kas × Tsu RIL population.

claim: Cytoplasmic variation had effects similar to, if not larger than, the largest individual nuclear locus.
source_text: This showed that the cytoplasmic variation had effects similar to, if not larger than, the largest individual nuclear locus.
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by the comparative analysis of effect sizes between cytoplasmic and nuclear loci presented in the results section, particularly in Figures 3-5.

claim: Inclusion of cytoplasmic variation into the genetic model greatly increased the explained phenotypic variation.
source_text: Inclusion of cytoplasmic variation into the genetic model greatly increased the explained phenotypic variation.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the model comparison data shown in Figure 8, which demonstrates increased variance explained when cytoplasmic terms are included.

claim: Cytoplasmic genetic variation was a central hub in the epistatic network controlling the plant metabolome.
source_text: Cytoplasmic genetic variation was a central hub in the epistatic network controlling the plant metabolome.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the network analysis presented in Figure 6, showing the cytoplasmic locus as one of the two nodes with the highest number of significant pairwise epistatic interactions.

claim: The cytoplasmic background could alter or hide pairwise epistasis between nuclear loci.
source_text: This epistatic influence manifested such that the cytoplasmic background could alter or hide pairwise epistasis between nuclear loci.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the three-way interaction analysis presented in Figure 9 and related supplements, showing how cytoplasmic variation modifies nuclear-nuclear epistatic interactions.

claim: Most genome analysis is typically confined to the nuclear genome.
source_text: However, most genome analysis is typically confined to the nuclear genome.
evidence_reasoning: This reflects established scientific practice in genomics research as acknowledged in the introduction.

claim: Organellar genomes play a central role in controlling organismal metabolism and function.
source_text: This is in contrast to the central role that the organellar genome plays in controlling organismal metabolism and function
evidence_reasoning: This is based on established scientific knowledge about the metabolic functions of mitochondria and chloroplasts.

claim: Genomic variation in human organelles has been linked to several severe diseases.
source_text: Genomic variation in human organelles has been linked to several severe diseases
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by citations to Wallace et al., 1988; Taylor and Turnbull, 2005; Schon et al., 2012.

claim: Cytoplasmic genome variation can influence high order phenotypes including fitness, cognition, and biomass in mice, yeast, and birds.
source_text: Additionally, the use of structured populations in mice, yeast, and birds have shown that cytoplasmic genome variation can influence high order phenotypes including fitness, cognition, and biomass
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to Roubertoux et al., 2003; Zeyl et al., 2005; Park et al., 2006; Dimitrov et al., 2009.

claim: Genetic variation in mitochondria is linked with cytoplasmic male sterility in plants.
source_text: In plants, genetic variation in mitochondria is also linked with large qualitative phenotypes, such as cytoplasmic male sterility
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to Hanson, 1991; Schnable and Wise, 1998.

claim: There is considerable genetic polymorphism in both the plastidic and mitochondrial genomes in Arabidopsis.
source_text: In contrast to the previous estimates of small effects, genomic sequencing within Arabidopsis has shown the presence of considerable genetic polymorphism in both the plastidic and mitochondrial genomes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Moison et al., 2010.

claim: Plant organelles (mitochondria and plastids) are central to the function of plant primary metabolism.
source_text: We focused on metabolomics because it is cost effective for large sample numbers and because plant organelles, mitochondria and plastids, are central to the function of plant primary metabolism, as well as many specialized metabolites in both energy generation and biosynthesis
evidence_reasoning: This is based on established knowledge about organellar function and supported by citations to Fiehn et al., 2000; Roessner et al., 2001; Fiehn, 2002.

claim: Within Arabidopsis, there are nearly 13,000 genes in the nuclear genome predicted to be involved in metabolic processes.
source_text: Within Arabidopsis, there are nearly 13,000 genes in the nuclear genome predicted to be involved in metabolic processes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Arabidopsis genome initiative, 2000.

claim: Approximately 3000 Arabidopsis nuclear genes may be targeted to the mitochondria and the plastid.
source_text: Within Arabidopsis, there are nearly 13,000 genes in the nuclear genome predicted to be involved in metabolic processes of which ∼3000 may be targeted to the mitochondria and the plastid
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Arabidopsis genome initiative, 2000.

claim: There are 88 total predicted genes in the plastidic genome of Arabidopsis.
source_text: Aiding these processes are 88 total predicted genes in the plastidic genome
evidence_reasoning: This is based on established genomic annotation data for Arabidopsis.

claim: There are 121 predicted genes in the mitochondrial genome of Arabidopsis.
source_text: and 121 in the mitochondrial genome
evidence_reasoning: This is based on established genomic annotation data for Arabidopsis.

claim: The Kas × Tsu RIL population was generated from a reciprocal cross with approximately half of the resulting lines carrying Kas organelles and the other half carrying Tsu organelles.
source_text: This population was generated from a reciprocal cross and approximately half of the resulting lines carry Kas organelles while the other half carry Tsu organelles allowing for explicit analysis of the influence of cytoplasmic genetic variation
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to McKay et al., 2008; Juenger et al., 2010, which describe the population structure.

claim: Genetic variation in the organelles influenced the accumulation of over 80% of the detectable metabolites.
source_text: Analysis of the Kas × Tsu RIL population metabolome showed that genetic variation in the organelles influenced the accumulation of over 80% of the detectable metabolites.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the heritability analysis presented in Figure 1 and related data.

claim: A total of 2435 metabolites were identified in over 25% of the RILs.
source_text: A total of 2435 metabolites were identified in over 25% of the RILs with 215 of these being known compounds and 2220 being unidentified compounds.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the metabolomic profiling data collected in the study.

claim: 215 of the identified metabolites were known compounds.
source_text: A total of 2435 metabolites were identified in over 25% of the RILs with 215 of these being known compounds
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the metabolomic profiling and compound identification performed in the study.

claim: 2220 of the identified metabolites were unidentified compounds.
source_text: with 215 of these being known compounds and 2220 being unidentified compounds
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the metabolomic profiling data where compounds could not be matched to known standards.

claim: 559 metabolites were identified in both experiments (161 known and 398 unknown).
source_text: Of these 2435 metabolites, 559 were identified in both experiments (161 known and 398 unknown)
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the overlap analysis of metabolites detected across the two independent experiments.

claim: Within the 316 lines of the Kas × Tsu population, 136 have the Kas cytoplasm and 180 have the Tsu cytoplasm.
source_text: Within the 316 lines for this population, 136 have the Kas cytoplasm and 180 have the Tsu cytoplasm.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the composition of the experimental population used in the study.

claim: The combined variance of the nuclear genome was larger than the variance due to cytoplasmic genome.
source_text: Interestingly, the combined variance of the nuclear genome was larger than the variance due to cytoplasmic genome (Figure 1).
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the heritability analysis presented in Figure 1.

claim: Cytoplasmic genetic variation affected more metabolites than any of the individual nuclear loci.
source_text: In contrast, cytoplasmic genetic variation affected more metabolites than any of the individual nuclear loci typically with larger effects
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the comparative analysis of locus effects presented in Figures 3-5.

claim: The cytoplasmic locus was one of the two nodes with the highest number of significant pairwise epistatic interactions, connecting to 6 of the 14 nuclear loci.
source_text: Importantly, the cytoplasmic locus was one of the two nodes with the highest number of significant pairwise epistatic interactions connecting to 6 of the 14 nuclear loci.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the epistatic network analysis presented in Figure 6.

claim: The M.I.83 nuclear locus had the highest level of interactions involving 7 of the other 13 nuclear loci.
source_text: The M.I.83 nuclear locus had the highest level of interactions involving 7 of the other 13 nuclear loci but did not interact directly with the cytoplasmic variation
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the epistatic network analysis presented in Figure 6.

claim: The M.I.83 nuclear locus did not interact directly with the cytoplasmic variation.
source_text: The M.I.83 nuclear locus had the highest level of interactions involving 7 of the other 13 nuclear loci but did not interact directly with the cytoplasmic variation
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the absence of a significant interaction term in the epistatic network analysis shown in Figure 6.

claim: The average network degree distribution was 3.5 ± 0.46 SE.
source_text: This level of interaction is higher than the average of the network degree distribution (3.5 ± 0.46 SE)
evidence_reasoning: This is a statistical summary of the epistatic network structure calculated from the data.

claim: For all cytonuclear epistatic interactions, the axis representing cytoplasmic genetic variation showed a wider phenotypic range than the axis representing variation in the nuclear locus.
source_text: For all cytonuclear epistatic interactions, the axis representing cytoplasmic genetic variation showed a wider phenotypic range than the axis representing variation in the nuclear locus
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the center of phenotype analysis presented in Figure 7 and supplements.

claim: The range of phenotypic effects in epistasis between two nuclear loci was typically smaller than that between nuclear and cytoplasmic genome.
source_text: Additionally, the range of phenotypic effects in epistasis between two nuclear loci was typically smaller than that between nuclear and cytoplasmic genome
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the comparative analysis of epistatic effects shown in Figure 7 and supplements.

claim: The cytoplasmic genome explained twice the variance as any individual nuclear locus on average.
source_text: Using the additive model, we generated per locus estimates of heritability that showed the cytoplasmic genome explained twice the variance as any individual nuclear locus on average
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the heritability estimates from the additive model analysis.

claim: There were polymorphisms spread out across a large number of genes in the organellar genomes including regulatory genes, unknown genes, and key energy genes.
source_text: This analysis showed that there were polymorphisms spread out across a large number of genes including regulatory genes, such as rpoC2 in the plastid, several unknown genes, and key energy genes, such as Rubisco large subunit.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the sequencing analysis of organellar genomes presented in Figure 5—source data 1.

claim: 32 of the 96 polymorphisms in the mitochondria were within the NADH dehydrogenase 7.
source_text: Specifically in the mitochondria, 32 of the 96 polymorphisms were within the NADH dehydrogenase 7
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the sequencing analysis of the mitochondrial genome presented in Figure 5—source data 1.

claim: 13 polymorphisms were found in four other NADH dehydrogenase complex genes in the mitochondria.
source_text: and a further 13 polymorphisms in four other NADH dehydrogenase complex genes
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the sequencing analysis of the mitochondrial genome presented in Figure 5—source data 1.

claim: The number of polymorphisms in NADH dehydrogenase genes is vastly more than would be expected by random chance.
source_text: This is vastly more polymorphisms than would be expected by random chance suggesting a change in NADH and related metabolism between the Kas and Tsu organelles (hyper-geometric test, p<0.001).
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by statistical testing (hypergeometric test) of the observed vs expected distribution of polymorphisms.

claim: Within this population the mitochondrial and plastidic genomes are perfectly co-inherited making it impossible to resolve the individual effects of the mitochondrial and plastidic genomes.
source_text: However, within this population the mitochondrial and plastidic genomes are perfectly co-inherited making it impossible to resolve the individual effects of the mitochondrial and plastidic genomes
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the maternal inheritance pattern of organelles in Arabidopsis and the structure of the reciprocal RIL population.

claim: It isn't possible to ascribe metabolites to specific subcellular compartments using a whole tissue extract.
source_text: Additionally, it isn't possible to ascribe metabolites to specific subcellular compartments using a whole tissue extract as most metabolites, even those synthesized in specific compartments, often accumulate in most compartments within a plant cell
evidence_reasoning: This is based on established knowledge about metabolite distribution in plant cells, supported by citation to Krueger et al., 2011.

claim: Including 10 three-way interactions significantly increased the total variance explained by the model for the distribution of metabolites.
source_text: We found that including these 10 new three-way interactions significantly increased the total variance explained by the model for the distribution of metabolites while only using less than 42% of the available degrees of freedom (Figure 8, t-test p<0.001).
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the model comparison analysis presented in Figure 8 with statistical testing.

claim: Previous work on natural variation in the plant metabolome had shown extensive two-way and three-way epistasis between nuclear loci.
source_text: Previous work on natural variation in the plant metabolome had shown extensive two-way and three-way epistasis between nuclear loci
evidence_reasoning: This refers to prior published work, though the specific citation is not provided in this sentence.

claim: Cytoplasmic genomes should be included in any future analysis of natural variation.
source_text: Thus cytoplasmic genomes should be included in any future analysis of natural variation, either by being included as a genotype in GWA studies or by designing future populations as reciprocal populations to allow for direct analysis of the cytoplasmic genomic variation in controlling the phenotype.
evidence_reasoning: This is a recommendation inferred from the findings of the study showing the importance of cytoplasmic variation.

claim: Seeds of the 341 lines of the Kas × Tsu recombinant inbred population were obtained from the Arabidopsis Biological Resource Center.
source_text: Seeds of the 341 lines of the Kas × Tsu recombinant inbred population were obtained from the Arabidopsis Biological Resource Center (ABRC, Columbus OH, USA)
evidence_reasoning: This describes the source of the biological materials used in the study.

claim: Four to five plants per line were grown, split into two randomized complete blocks per experiment with two independent experiments.
source_text: We grew a total of four to five plants per line, split into two randomized complete blocks per experiment with two independent experiments separated by approximately 3 months.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the experimental design and replication structure.

claim: Plants were harvested 31 days after sowing for metabolomics analysis.
source_text: 31 days after sowing, we harvested plants for metabolomics analysis.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the timing of sample collection in the experimental protocol.

claim: A set of 10 lines with aberrant or genetically impossible glucosinolate profiles were removed from the analysis, leaving a total 316 lines.
source_text: From the analysis of glucosinolates, a set of 10 lines with aberrant or genetically impossible glucosinolate profiles based on the known parentage were removed from the analysis, leaving a total 316 lines.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the quality control filtering applied to the dataset.

claim: Composite interval mapping was implemented using cim function in R/qtl package with a 10 cM window.
source_text: For QTL detection, composite interval mapping (CIM) was implemented using cim function in R/qtl package with a 10 cM window.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the specific computational method and parameters used for QTL mapping.

claim: QTLs with a LOD score above 2 were considered significant for further analysis.
source_text: QTLs with a LOD score above 2 were considered significant for further analysis
evidence_reasoning: This describes the statistical threshold used for declaring significant QTLs.

claim: The declaration of statistically significant QTLs was based on permutation-derived empirical thresholds using 1000 permutations for each mapped trait.
source_text: The declaration of statistically significant QTLs was based on permutation-derived empirical thresholds using 1000 permutations for each mapped trait.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the statistical method used to establish significance thresholds for QTL detection.

claim: There is no significant single marker or pairwise segregation distortion in this population.
source_text: There is no significant single marker or pairwise segregation distortion in this population indicating that the model is balanced for all markers
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to McKay et al., 2008, which characterized the population structure.

claim: RIL populations have a significant false negative QTL detection issue.
source_text: We used this pairwise epistasis model per metabolite because we had previous evidence that RIL populations have a significant false negative QTL detection issue
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Chan et al., 2011.

claim: The plant cytoplasmic genomes contain only about 1% of the number of genes as found within the nuclear genome.
source_text: The plant cytoplasmic genomes contain only about 1% of the number of genes as found within the nuclear genome
evidence_reasoning: This is based on established genomic data, supported by citation to Arabidopsis genome initiative, 2000.

claim: Arabidopsis typically shows uni-parental/maternal mode of inheritance for organelles.
source_text: Separating the two genomes to resolve their relative roles would require identifying rare individuals where the two organelles show bi-parental inheritance instead of the uni-parental/maternal mode of inheritance typical for Arabidopsis
evidence_reasoning: This is based on established knowledge about Arabidopsis genetics, supported by citation to Azhagiri and Maliga, 2007.

claim: Metabolite identity was determined by comparing retention time and mass to the 2007 UC Davis Genome Center Metabolomics Facility metabolites database.
source_text: Metabolite identity was determined by comparing retention time and mass to the 2007 UC Davis Genome Center Metabolomics Facility metabolites database
evidence_reasoning: This describes the method used for metabolite identification in the study.

claim: Mixed samples were run approximately every 20 samples to optimize the peak identification and quantification algorithms and to control for variation in the detection.
source_text: Mixed samples were run approximately every 20 samples to optimize the peak identification and quantification algorithms and to control for variation in the detection
evidence_reasoning: This describes the quality control procedures used in the metabolomics analysis.

claim: Metabolite abundance was median normalized prior to analysis to account for any technical variation between samples.
source_text: Metabolite abundance was median normalized prior to analysis to account for any technical variation between samples.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the data normalization procedure applied before statistical analysis.

claim: The QTLs detected at the previously characterized and cloned glucosinolate AOP locus lies underneath the M.IV.17 metabolomics hotspot.
source_text: The QTLs detected at the previously characterized and cloned glucosinolate AOP locus lies underneath the M.IV.17 metabolomics hotspot
evidence_reasoning: This connects the detected QTL hotspot to a previously characterized locus, supported by citations to Magrath et al., 1994; Kliebenstein et al., 2001c, a; Kroymann et al., 2003.

claim: Significance values were corrected for multiple testing within a model using FDR (<0.05).
source_text: Significance values were corrected for multiple testing within a model using FDR (<0.05).
evidence_reasoning: This describes the statistical correction method applied to control for multiple testing.

claim: The 10% threshold for network visualization was chosen as an additional multiple testing correction to provide a more conservative image of the network.
source_text: The 10% threshold was chosen as an additional multiple testing correction to provide a more conservative image of the network.
evidence_reasoning: This explains the rationale for the threshold choice in the network analysis.

claim: Kas-1 and Tsu-1 sequence reads were obtained from NCBI.
source_text: Kas-1 and Tsu-1 reads were obtained from NCBI (www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/, accessions SRX246466 and SRX246442 respectively)
evidence_reasoning: This describes the source of the sequencing data used for organellar genome analysis.

claim: Sequence reads were aligned using Bowtie2 to the Col-0 mitochondrial and chloroplast references obtained from TAIR.
source_text: and aligned using Bowtie2 to the Col-0 mitochondrial and chloroplast references obtained from TAIR
evidence_reasoning: This describes the bioinformatics method used for sequence alignment.

claim: SNP discovery between Kas-1 and Tsu-1 was carried out using the UnifiedGenotyper package of GATK.
source_text: SNP discovery between Kas-1 and Tsu-1 was carried out using the UnifiedGenotyper package of GATK
evidence_reasoning: This describes the computational method used for identifying genetic variants.

claim: Previous reciprocal F2 populations typically have generated the impression that cytoplasmic effects on phenotypic variation are quite small in plants.
source_text: However, these reciprocal F2 populations typically have generated the impression that cytoplasmic effects on phenotypic variation are quite small in plants possibly because of an inability to account for interactions between the nuclear and cytoplasmic genomes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to Singh, 1965; Crane and Nyquist, 1967; Eenink and Garretsen, 1980; Miura et al., 1997; Primomo et al., 2002.

claim: The inability to account for interactions between the nuclear and cytoplasmic genomes may explain why previous studies found small cytoplasmic effects.
source_text: However, these reciprocal F2 populations typically have generated the impression that cytoplasmic effects on phenotypic variation are quite small in plants possibly because of an inability to account for interactions between the nuclear and cytoplasmic genomes
evidence_reasoning: This is a speculative explanation for the discrepancy between previous findings and the current study's results.

claim: Variation in the organellar genomes could directly influence the function of any nuclear gene functioning within the organelle.
source_text: Thus, variation in the organellar genomes could directly influence the function of any of nuclear gene functioning within the organelle
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the functional relationship between organellar and nuclear genes, supported by citations to Etterson et al., 2007; Tang et al., 2007; Wolf, 2009.

claim: Metabolism is an ideal phenotype to use for testing how cytoplasmic variation can influence phenotypic variation.
source_text: This suggests that metabolism is an ideal phenotype to use for testing how cytoplasmic variation can influence phenotypic variation.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the central role of organelles in metabolism and the large number of metabolic genes.

claim: The affected metabolites included key parts of central metabolism and some of the most specialized metabolites.
source_text: The affected metabolites included key parts of central metabolism and some of the most specialized metabolites (Figures 1, 5 and 6).
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the metabolite mapping data presented in the referenced figures.

claim: Cytonuclear epistasis explained as much, if not more, metabolic variation than the combined additive effects of the nuclear loci.
source_text: This cytonuclear epistasis explained as much, if not more, metabolic variation than the combined additive effects of the nuclear loci.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the variance partitioning analysis comparing additive and epistatic models.

claim: The cytoplasmic genome controlled larger phenotypic changes than the nuclear locus within a cytonuclear interaction.
source_text: In addition, the cytoplasmic genome controlled larger phenotypic changes than the nuclear locus within a cytonuclear interaction (Figure 7).
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the center of phenotype analysis presented in Figure 7.

claim: The cytoplasmic background plays a key role in determining how natural variation within nuclear loci will function.
source_text: Thus, the cytoplasmic genetic background plays a key role in determining how natural variation within nuclear loci will function.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the observed three-way interactions showing that cytoplasmic variation modifies nuclear epistasis.

claim: The effect of the cytoplasmic genetic variation was spread out across nearly all of primary metabolism.
source_text: The effect of the cytoplasmic genetic variation was spread out across nearly all of primary metabolism making it impossible to ascribe a causal link with solely plastidic or mitochondrial genes (Figure 5).
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the metabolic pathway mapping shown in Figure 5.

claim: Organellar genomes could be playing a role in the cytoplasmic genetic influence on metabolite variation.
source_text: Thus, organellar genomes could be playing a role in the cytoplasmic genetic influence on metabolite variation, but given their coinheritance, it is not possible to resolve the direct causal polymorphisms.
evidence_reasoning: This is speculative reasoning about the potential mechanistic basis of the observed effects.

claim: Separating the two organellar genomes to resolve their relative roles would require identifying rare individuals where the two organelles show bi-parental inheritance.
source_text: Separating the two genomes to resolve their relative roles would require identifying rare individuals where the two organelles show bi-parental inheritance instead of the uni-parental/maternal mode of inheritance typical for Arabidopsis
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the coinheritance problem and knowledge of organellar inheritance patterns.

claim: The polymorphisms could be within the organellar genes that are required to facilitate the function of the several thousand nuclear genes whose protein products are transported into the organelles.
source_text: Alternatively, the polymorphisms could be within the organellar genes that are required to facilitate the function of the several thousand nuclear genes whose protein products are transported into the organelles and function there
evidence_reasoning: This is speculative reasoning about potential mechanisms, with citation to Ajjawi et al., 2010.

claim: It is possible that the polymorphisms in the organelle impact retrograde signaling pathways, thus altering the function of the nuclear regulatory mechanisms.
source_text: Finally, it is possible that the polymorphisms in the organelle impact retrograde signaling pathways, thus altering the function of the nuclear regulatory mechanisms
evidence_reasoning: This is speculative reasoning about potential mechanisms, supported by citations to Vinti et al., 2000; Larkin et al., 2003; Estavillo et al., 2011; Xiao et al., 2012.

claim: Identifying the specific causal polymorphisms within the cytoplasmic genomes will require direct whole genome sequencing of the organellar genomes from all available genotypes.
source_text: Identifying the specific causal polymorphisms within the cytoplasmic genomes will require direct whole genome sequencing of the organellar genomes from all available genotypes to query the extent of natural variation in the organellar genome
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred as a necessary future approach, with citation to Cao et al., 2011.

claim: An alternative approach may be to identify the causal genes underlying the nuclear loci involved in three-way interactions with the cytoplasm to triangulate the identity of the cytoplasmic gene.
source_text: An alternative may be to identify the causal genes underlying the nuclear loci involved in three-way interactions with the cytoplasm to triangulate the identity of the cytoplasmic gene.
evidence_reasoning: This is a speculative suggestion for an alternative experimental approach.

claim: Natural genetic variation in the organellar genomes while frequently ignored will have to be kept at the front of future experimental approaches designed to understand the evolution and genetic architecture of organismal phenotypes.
source_text: Natural genetic variation in the organellar genomes while frequently ignored will have to be kept at the front of future experimental approaches designed to understand the evolution and genetic architecture of organismal phenotypes.
evidence_reasoning: This is a conclusion inferred from the findings of the study about the importance of cytoplasmic variation.
